notes.title: HANK HOODIE & LITTLE BEAR UPDATE
notes.content:
Little Bear Update

Hello everyone. I’m Rareș from the Bear team and this is a little end of the year update about Bear and Breakfast and the people behind it.

We’ve been keeping quiet these past weeks and months, and like last time, I’d like to apologize for the radio silence. It’s been hard to focus on anything other than the ongoing issues we’ve been facing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/fa92668eb8a86d77a798bb6155692609148126c7.jpg

About the team:
It's been a year since we first posted about the serious health issues that our team is facing, namely our lead artist having been diagnosed with stage 4 breast cancer. For the three of us, confronting this situation has been difficult.

Unfortunately, I don’t have a positive update to share at this time. We’re still dealing with the consequences of the disease affecting our colleague, friend and loved one as best we can while trying to keep a steady workflow and positive outlook.

About the game:
Work on Bear and Breakfast, its upcoming update, future plans for both the game and the studio as a whole have all been affected. The pace at which we’ve been able to work on the promised features has been impacted, and while we continue to push through this, the game is still being updated with fixes for bugs and issues that you've been reporting (thank you). 

I wish I could offer a more in-depth update on our situation, but that’s all that I can share at the moment. Once we’re past this difficult time, I hope I’ll be able to go into more details.

Hank Hoodie!

In case you missed it, we just announced a new campaign through Makeship for the Hank Hoodie! They’ve been excellent to work with for our past Plushie campaigns, and this hoodie has been in the works for a long time. As before, the Hank hoodie will only exist if the campaign goal is reached, so grab one if you feel like having a cozy friend with you everywhere.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/a70a512c77fda916a78974abee53e3a16d4fee11.jpg

It’s very soft, the ears are embroidered and it has a little tail!

It’s truly the most adorable way to keep yourself cozy through the cold harshness of reality. While wearing clothes in public is optional for bears, it's unfortunately frowned upon for you, so get the next best thing to a grizzly coat of fur, the Hank Hoodie! 

Grab one here! bear.game/hoodie

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/0c52178199d50241fa83b980bf476340cf1c2dcb.jpg

The Game
As before, our support team (thank you Tass) and Andu have been keeping tabs on bug reports and putting out patches semi-regularly. Today we've just launched patch 1.8.29 addressing a couple of recent bugs (details below).

Your ongoing support is very valuable to us, regardless if you’re just finding the game now or have been a friend of the bear for a while, your messages and presence is felt and very appreciated. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/338743fa9657ba159f85f6579cf854a8225c4b61.jpg

If you’re just finding out about the adorable Bear game for the first time, or have been on the fence waiting for a discount, I’m happy to report that today marks the start of our deepest discount yet, 50% off during the Steam Winter Sale as well as comparable promotions on most of our other platforms.

Here’s an update to our last Frequently Asked Questions:

FAQ

When’s the game update coming?
Given the current development of our situation, we’re not comfortable making another promise for a timeline if we’re not 100% we can keep our word. It will be ready when it’s ready. We know how excited some of you are about more content and story for the game, we hope to be able to deliver this soon. Thank you for understanding.

What’s gonna be in it?

 New Story Content, picking up where the original game left off
 New Areas, New Hotels, New Furniture and New Characters
 A new and more flexible sandbox style Game Mode
 It will be available for free on all platforms where you can currently find the game
Why is it taking so long?
Small team dealing with major health issues, causing slower development.

Why not just hire more people?
That was the plan until we got the bad news. 
When the game launched, our core team consisted of me (game/studio director), Ioana (art director) and Andu (lead programmer) as the three full-time employees (plus a handful of contracted members, which are invaluable to us and the game, but were not permanent team members). We were looking to expand the core team, keep updating Bear and Breakfast as well as start working on our next game in tandem. 
Ioana’s diagnosis meant that both her and myself, two leads, were suddenly unavailable, or at best, unreliable. Hiring new people in this environment would be irresponsible, as well as unfair to any new team members, who would need to be onboarded and who deserve a proper manager and team to work with.

End of FAQ

Speaking frankly

Every time I’ve had to write one of these updates, I’m filled with a mix of guilt and humility. On one hand, I’m incredibly grateful for the amount of support we’ve received from all of you over the years, despite a lack of updates and communication recently. On the other hand, I’m very conscious about the promises we’ve made and never wanting to let it seem like we take this support for granted. It’s through your love that we’re able to navigate this very difficult part of our life, and it’s honestly bitter-sweet. 
Despite everything, we keep going because of all of you. Thank you for being here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/b7c0c01502618735addf9afdbd82162b171b2da5.png
Ioana, our lead artist, wearing the incredible Hank Hoodie!

notes.title: State Of The Bear (and Breakfast)
notes.content:
State Of The Bear

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/2da9ac8c0b7045b4456236faef3e240ae95eb8c5.jpg

Hello everyone. This is not a political management spinoff game with Bears (although..), but it is an update about Bear and Breakfast and the team of people behind it.

I’d like to start by apologizing for the radio silence. We’ve been focusing on health related things that have left us kind of physically and mentally exhausted. It’s been a while since we’ve told you what’s been happening with the team and Bear and Breakfast, so it’s time to rectify that.

TL;DR about the team:
We’re doing okay. Our Art Director, Ioana’s been undergoing treatment for breast cancer for the past 8 months and will soon go through surgery, followed by radiation therapy. We are currently cautious, but hopeful.

TL;DR about the game:
Work on the free update we announced some time ago is still ongoing and we’re doing our best to have it ready to ship this year. We have a couple of smaller, but special announcements (not update related) coming up sooner, in probably less than a month.

That’s the quick summary. If you’d like to know more about the situation, here’s a few more details:

The Team

In case you missed it, a few months ago we announced that our Art Director Ioana has been diagnosed with Stage 4 Metastatic Breast Cancer. Stage 4 means that the cancer is not isolated to just its point of origin, but it has also spread to other parts of her body. In her case, it spread to two of her bones. It was devastating news, especially for Ioana, but also for myself and the rest of our team.

Since our last update, she has been steadily following the treatment provided by her oncologist and is feeling okay. Early signs are positive and indicate the treatment is at least partially effective, which has recently prompted her doctor to recommend surgery and radiation therapy. Ioana is now preparing to go through that surgery in a couple of weeks and her recovery will inform our next steps. In short, we are cautious but hopeful that things are going in the right direction.

The Game

Work on Bear and Breakfast has been slow, but relatively steady. Our support team (thank you Tass) and Andu have been keeping tabs on bug reports, as well as tinkering away at the update. In general, working on the game has been a good excuse to not think about health stuff.
Our plan is to release it for free once we’re happy with the amount of content and testing we can get done.
Here’s a sneak peak at some of the new content as well as the new more sandbox-y game mode:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/6961dba356f29c4a598924e69460faf4b9bc64c4.png

[previewyoutube=8xa7wvDmTs4;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8xa7wvDmTs4[/previewyoutube]

And here’s a list of frequent questions we’ve gotten:
FAQ


When’s the game update coming?
Later this year.

What’s gonna be in it?
New Story Content, picking up where the original game left off
New Areas, New Hotels, New Furniture and New Characters
A new and more flexible sandbox style Game Mode
It will be available for free on all platforms where you can currently find the game

Why is it taking so long?
Small team dealing with major health issues, causing slower development.

Why not just hire more people?
That was the plan until we got the bad news. 
When the game launched, our core team consisted of me (game/studio director), Ioana (art director) and Andu (lead programmer) as the three full-time employees (plus a handful of contracted members, which are invaluable to us and the game, but were not permanent team members). We were looking to expand the core team, keep updating Bear and Breakfast as well as start working on our next game in tandem. 
Ioana’s diagnosis meant that both her and myself, two leads, were suddenly unavailable, or at best, unreliable. Hiring new people in this environment would be irresponsible, as well as unfair to any new team members, who would need to be onboarded and who deserve a proper manager and team to work with.

What’s next for the team?
Step 1: Kick cancer’s ass.
Step 2: Make more bear stuff.
Step 3: ???
Step 4: Profit and make many more games for years to come.

Anything Else?

Well, yes, since you asked. 
We have two small non-update related announcements coming soon, possibly of the merchandise variety. More on that real soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/bacaa7a3826f5d049e9f9a6314069316ce44a851.jpg

One last thing

Before I go, I wanted to give a short but very sincere Thank You for the frankly inconceivable amount of support you’ve given us since the day we announced our little bear game. We are now able to take this time and care for ourselves and our loved ones because of your support. It means the world to us. We want to keep making more and better games, and it’s because of you that we’re able to even entertain that possibility in our future, even under these circumstances. We keep pushing forward.

Thank u, love u
- Rares from the bear team

notes.title: Hotfix Number TWO! Patch 1.8.22
notes.content:
Main Menu Freeze Fixed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/730a92793fab6f083e81c7d8d772ae7fc911bbdf.jpg

Hello for the third time in such a short while! We finally found what was causing some players to experience an unresponsive main menu. We spent the majority of our day installing an launching the game on almost 20 laptops, PC and everything in between, trying to find the common thread between all of these machines and we found that it wasn't a performance issue. As it turns out, a recent flag in one of our controller updates affected any device that had touch capability, disabling input if touch was enabled (for instance to disable the trackpad on a Dualsense 4).
This is why a pretty large but inconsistent number of you were affected.  The recent hotfix should fix this.

1.8.22 Hotfix Patch Notes - Bear and Breakfast
28 NOV 2023

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that disabled input for the game on some touch capable devices.
 

Thank you to everyone for being patient and to those that chose to help us figure out the issue1

Love u,
-Rares

notes.title: Patch 1.8.2 - A message from the Bear Team
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/a1742e2663ed00e3779217d4110080ce776c0c47.jpg

Dear Bear Friends,

While this is a regular game update news post, I would also like to tell you about the state of us, the Bear crew (especially for those of you that don't follow us on socials where we've already relayed this message):

For the past few months we have been tinkering away at Bear and Breakfast, working on the plans we outlined last summer. We've been very lucky to have a small but great team of 3 people able to work on this full time. We've recently learned of some serious health issues that will impact our team which we'd like to share with you.

Unfortunately, our art-director Ioana has been diagnosed with Stage 4 Metastatic Breast Cancer. She will focus all of her efforts on treatment and getting better. This also impacts Rares, our game director and Ioana's husband of 12 years. Our lead programmer Andu has been hard at work updating the game, fixing bugs and preparing a port for a new platform. He will keep working on the game as much as he can.

Given this information, the upcoming expansion patch for Bear and Breakfast is delayed. We will do our best to keep you updated on a new release window and the team's status.
In the meantime, things we've been working on before we got this news such as controller updates, bug fixes and the new port will still be launching (very) soon.

One of Andu's efforts has solidified in today's patch, which aims at vastly improving the controller scheme of our game as well as adding official Brazilian Portuguese. This will impact you the most if you're playing on Steam Deck or using a controller. Here's what this patch contains:

For any issues you might encounter, please report them at our support page and we’ll do our best to help you out. (armor.ag/bugbear)

As a final note, this is not news we ever imagined we'd be sharing with you, but it's important to us that you know what's going on with the people behind the Bear game. I won't lie, this sucks. Your support has been very important to us and continues to make a big impact as we navigate this extremely difficult period in our lives. We're doing our best to take care of our team and get back to making video games. Thank you for caring about us and our little Bear game.

Thank u, love u
-Rares

notes.title: Regarding pricing in certain regions
notes.content:
Hey, bear enthusiasts! Wanted to give you all the heads up that Bear and Breakfast will have its price adjusted in certain regions starting today, in order to line up with our current US base price ($19.99).

Most platforms, including Steam, provide pricing conversion guidance for developers which helps us convert our base USD price into reasonable amounts for every other region in which our game is available.

Steam has recently updated these recommendations and we will be amending our pricing accordingly. Most regions will see a small or no change at all, but a few will see more noticeable increases. 

This is due to two main things:

 Currency exchange rates have shifted quite a bit since Steam last made recommendations, so this update catches us up to current rates. Naturally, currency values change all the time, so Steam plans to update these recommendations annually. 

 Many professionals have observed lately that a disproportionate number of sales have been coming from regions where games are priced significantly lower when converted to USD, suggesting some players are using VPNs to "currency-hop" in order to buy games for far less than their local economy should afford them. 

We want as many people as possible to be able to play our games, but we also need to be able to make games sustainably. If the current price is above what you feel it's worth to you, we will continue to participate in Steam’s sale events.

If you have any questions, we’ll be around keeping an eye on comments, or you can chat with us in our Discord. Thank you for your understanding and for all the love and support you’ve given us. We couldn’t have made this game without you!

If you'd like to learn more about how Steam handles these things, check out their recent Steamworks announcement.

Hanks so much, 
Gummy Cat

notes.title: Known Issues and How To Fix Them
notes.content:
Hi bear friends! ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Let's cut straight to the chase! You've all been incredibly great and patient as we go through this launch. We're incredibly grateful and we're doing our best to fix anything and everything you've been sending our way.
Here's a list of Known Issues that we've been getting the most reports on, and how you can fix them in your game, while we work on a permanent patch.

Errors on Main Menu / On First Startup
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/97ecc2881168ba6e42c297c0c69804f00b0d97cd.jpg
If the main menu reads “LOC ERROR” or if Save Slots are not being responsive when clicked, this can happen if you played the Bear and Breakfast Demo or a preview build at any point. 
To fix this, follow these steps:
[olist] Close the game.
 Enter any Windows folder
 Paste this file address in the folder address bar and hit Enter / Return %AppData%/../LocalLow/GummyCat/BearAndBreakfast/
 Delete everything inside the folder
 Launch the game again.[/olist]Here’s a step by step video on how to fix this issue:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p-8-nVpr7mQ
Hank got stuck
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/e080acf0899547897e2081540de641d041e564e6.jpg
Poor Hank! If Hank gets stuck in the environment (damn Swamps), you can use the “Bear Stuck” feature to free the Bear. To do this, follow these steps:
[olist] Press ESC to access the Pause menu while in the game
 Click on the icon in the top left of the Screen and use the feature.[/olist]I ran out of money and can’t progress
If you run out of money before you’re able to set up a steady income through building bedrooms and accepting guests, follow these steps:
[olist] If you are under 100 coins, visit Margaret, your mom in Thicket. She will provide you with some extra pocket money. [/olist]Some Text is Obstructed or Interface Panels are off-screen
The game officially supports a 16:9 aspect ratio. Other resolutions might cause some of the UI to misbehave or be hidden behind other elements. To fix this, follow these steps:
[olist] Change the game’s resolution to a 16:9 aspect ratio resolution, such as 1920x1080[/olist]I can’t edit or delete rooms
While not explicitly shown, it is possible to edit or delete any room in the game. While using the Workbench, you can click inside any room which will bring up the Room Details panel that has Edit and Delete options for each room.

No money from guests
Once a guest completes their stay and leaves in the morning, the money they give should automatically be awarded in your inventory, and the amount should be reflected in their Review details. We’ve received reports of money not being awarded. A temporary fix for this issue is:
[olist]  Save and restart the game[/olist]This should resolve the issue, but only moving forward and not retroactively.
We are aware of this issue and are working on a permanent fix!

Guests won’t leave
If a room is modified or edited while a guest is staying in it, it is possible for guests to remain stuck in place and not leave. In order to fix this, you need to:
[olist] Delete the room and remake it. The guest should then leave.[/olist]We are aware of this issue and are working on a permanent fix. In the meantime, please free your guests as holding them in a managerial limbo is against most laws, I think.

Bathroom Door showing a No Entry icon
When a guest uses a bathroom, the door will lock and a No Entry icon will appear over it. Only one guest can use a bathroom at a time. We’ve received reports of the No Entry sign not clearing and other guests not being able to use the Bathroom. A temporary fix for this issue is:
[olist] Delete and rebuild the bathroom.
 Alternatively, just wait until the next morning and the error should clear by itself[/olist]This should resolve the issue momentarily, but not prevent it from recurring.
We are aware of this issue and are working on a permanent fix!

Hank Can’t Sleep
The game will allow for sleeping only between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM in-game time. Before obtaining the Watch, the way to tell it’s midnight is to check that the moon icon is visibly centered in the top right of the screen, over the minimap. Once you are within that time-frame, you can click the “Moon” button in the bottom adventure menu to sleep.
We are working towards making it possible to go to sleep earlier to address this and make the game’s pace feel overall more snappy in the beginning.

Can’t build at the Campsite
We received reports of players not being able to build the Campfire room inside the grounds of the Campsite in Highlake. Make sure you’re trying to build the actual Campfire Room type from Build Mode, but if the issue persists, try these these steps:
[olist] Try changing your resolution to a lower option
 Try changing between Windowed and Fullscreen mode[/olist]Some players have reported that it has resolved the issue, but it is not guaranteed.
We are aware of this issue and are working on a permanent fix!

Settings or Keybinds Issues
If you encounter issues with Settings or Keybinds, please try the following steps:
[olist] Go to the Pause Menu, click Options and then click Reset Alll in the lower left corner of the panel
 If that isn’t possible, force close the game, reopen it and follow the above step through the Main Menu
 If that’s not possible or the above steps do not fix the issue, close the game and then delete the GameSettings file found in 
 C:/Users/ YOURUSER /AppData/LocalLow/GummyCat/BearAndBreakfast[/olist]Game locks when Sleeping
We’ve received reports of the game locking after using the Sleep function. You will need to force close the game and restart. We are aware of this issue and are working on a fix!

Game is stuck during the opening scene
We’ve received reports of the game getting stuck if closed or force quit during the opening scenes, before Hank is shown in his room. This happens because the game cannot properly be saved during the first initial cutscenes. To resolve this issue, follow these steps:[olist] Quit to menu or force close the game and open it
 Delete the current save and start a new one
 Or start a new game on an alternative, empty save slot[/olist]Can I split stacks?
Yes! You can use shift+click to split any stack.

I think I lost an item, can I get it back?
The game features a “Lost and Found” feature. If you accidentally lose an item, or for example receive a quest item with a full inventory, the game will automatically show a Lost and Found button to the left of the Inventory button in the bottom adventure menu. Click it to reveal a temporary container from which you can grab your lost item and place it back into your inventory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555682/823c096d76b37b640f5cbf86eb28ff3e6232ebf6.jpg

We'll keep updating the list as well as keeping up with you all here on the Steam Forums, on our Discord (https://discord.gg/bearandbreakfast). If you encounter other bugs not found on this list, please provide as much info as you can about the issue via our support site (http://armor.ag/bugbear) and we'll do our best to get back to you in a timely manner.

Thank you all for playing the game and helping us make it better. We're doing everything we can to make sure there's no bear left behind and a hotfix patch is currently in development!

Thank u love u,
- Rares from the bear team

C:\Users\BearComputer\AppData\LocalLow\GummyCat\BearAndBreakfast
